playback_note: Opt-in flexible written ringing durations, with timing and guitar contacts chosen together by the complete joint tail-aware solve. 85 BPM throughout; identical GM30 sampled guitar, Sonivox soundfont, gain 0.5, 44.1 kHz mono PCM. Full nine-bar generated idea; there is no backing band or extra source context. The roll shows actual native gate/onset/contact changes against untouched original004; additional attacks have their own identities. Written-hold-only changes are counted separately and may not change a gate color. Every MIDI release is checked. The existing exporter stops at score end, so post-score soundfont decay is not included or certified. Original has one retained shared-channel same-pitch overlap; alternatives have none. No physical-playability or musical-quality claim. Private implementation checkpoint; the generator is not deployed.
